title: From Residential Real Estate to Commercial: How One REMAX Agent Found Her Niche
summary: Experience in personal short-term rentals helped Elizabeth Heil with REMAX Achievers recognize the potential of commercial real estate. With encouragement from the REMAX network, the former residential specialist expanded into the commercial market, building a foundation for future growth.
body_markdown:
After more than 15 years in residential real estate, Elizabeth Heil was ready to expand her business in a new direction.


An agent with REMAX Achievers in Columbus, Ohio, Heil spent the past eight years purchasing, renovating and managing short-term rental properties. While residential sales remained her primary focus, that hands-on experience gave her a deeper understanding of the investment side of real estate and fueled her interest in commercial opportunities.


As her knowledge and confidence grew, so did her desire to help other investors identify and pursue similar opportunities. What she needed was the education, connections and support to take the next step.


She found those resources through the REMAX network.


##


Elizabeth Heil, REMAX Achievers, Columbus, OH


**Finding Mentorship Through REMAX**


While Heil had been considering commercial real estate for some time, attending the REMAX Global Commercial Symposium – the premier annual event designed specifically for REMAX Commercial professionals – helped move those plans forward.


At the 2026 event in Seattle, Washington, she connected with Kristie Kimnach, Executive Director of REMAX Commercial. She also met Nathan Bragg, Director of the Commercial Division at REMAX Time Realty in Rancho Cucamonga, California. Both encouraged and advised her as she explored the commercial side of the business.


After the symposium, Bragg continued to mentor her on commercial real estate fundamentals, property presentation and marketing strategies.


“Nathan taught me how to present a property and introduced me to tools I could use, including AI,” says Heil. “He’s been a real morale booster.”


Bragg also encouraged Heil to pursue her CCIM designation, one of commercial real estate’s most recognized professional credentials, providing essential knowledge and skills.


“As soon as I enrolled in CCIM, I knew it was for me,” she says.


Heil is now working toward her full CCIM designation and has joined the Ohio Business Brokers Association to expand her knowledge and connections even further.


**Making the Leap from Residential to Commercial**


Today, Heil leads commercial brokerage activity at REMAX Achievers. Her current listings include[Oakwood Cabins](https://protect.checkpoint.com/v2/r01/___https:/www.remaxcommercial.com/xnslqj-uwtujwyDd?qthfynts-fiiwjxx=7b6a5-tmnt-c8-sjB-uqDrtzym-tm-9/*~*/9&yDuj=ktw-xfqj&uwtu-ni=9677b5*~*___.YzJ1OnRoZXJlYWxicm9rZXJhZ2UyMTpjOmdvb2dsZV9tYWlsX2F0dGFjaG1lbnQ6ZjAzYmY0ZjJkOTFmZTliZDY5NmU4MmI3YmZlZDgyY2I6NzowZGFjOjQxYjlmMWE4YzRiNzI4NTc3ZWY5ZjQ5ZWNjODkzY2VjNDZkYWZlZTU4ODA3NWFlMDE0NTgwNDUxNzRjODI4Njk6cDpUOlQ) , a four-cabin short-term rental property in Ohio’s Hocking Hills, a popular tourist destination.


One of the biggest adjustments in moving from residential to commercial real estate, Heil says, has been understanding financing.


While residential buyers are typically preapproved or prequalified for a mortgage, commercial financing is often based on the income and financial performance of the property or business. Understanding that distinction has been an important part of her transition into commercial brokerage.

**A Network of Support**


Throughout her transition, Heil says support from the REMAX network has been invaluable. As a former member of the U.S. Coast Guard, she has benefited from connections through the REMAX Veterans network as well as Women in Commercial Real Estate, both of which have provided opportunities to build relationships, exchange ideas and learn from others in the industry.


She also credits Paul and Marilena Cugini, Broker/Owners of REMAX Achievers, for supporting her growth since she joined the brokerage in 2010.


“They have backed me every step of the way,” says Heil. “They believed in me from the beginning. They’re like family.”


For Heil, the move into commercial real estate was a natural next step, built on years of experience as an investor, property owner and residential agent. With support from the REMAX network and a commitment to continued learning, she has transformed a personal interest into a growing area of her business.


*Learn more about education, networking and business opportunities through*[REMAX Commercial](https://www.remaxcommercial.com/) *.*
